page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.48xlarge is a local SSD storage-focused server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The system is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz, providing 192 dedicated vCPUs. Memory capacity stands at 1152.0 GB of RAM, yielding an allocation of 6.0 GB of system memory per vCPU. The instance contains no discrete graphics hardware accelerators.

A central component of this instance configuration is its high-density local storage subsystem, which features 30,717 GB of integrated local SSD storage. Network connectivity is scaled to complement the storage capacity, delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 190 Gbps. The instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating standard private networking or optional elastic IP assignment for external connectivity.

The dense hardware configuration provides significant local compute, storage, and networking capacity in a single virtual machine footprint. Because the high storage volume relies on local SSDs, data durability models require application-level replication to mitigate hardware fault risks. The instance profile is suitable for large-scale distributed databases, big data analytics engines, search indices, and high-throughput data warehousing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i5ge.48xlarge is a storage-focused instance type within the Local SSDs family, designed for high-throughput, data-heavy computing environments. Powered by the Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, it delivers 192 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 1152.0 GB of RAM, equating to 6.0 GB per core. The instance bundles 30,717 GB of local SSD storage directly on the node, paired with a high baseline network throughput of 190 Gbps and zero discrete GPUs. This architecture provides high local I/O capacity and massive compute density, though users must manage data resiliency given the local SSD profile. The configuration is suited for large distributed databases, high-capacity big data processing, data warehousing, and real-time analytics pipelines requiring high local storage volumes alongside wide network bandwidth.
